node.label: Decreased total CD8+ T cell proportion
node.definition: Abnormal decrease of cytotoxic CD3+CD8+ T cells, measured as percentage of total CD3+ T cells in the blood, compared to a reference range for a given sex and age-group. These are usually measured within the TCR alpha/beta positive population.
